patch.value: Model session-suppressed row references in public SDK result types

The existing session mapper replaces declared rows with {id,context_ref} when their facts were already served. PmReadOutputResult<Result> and PmReadOutputResultFor still retain the original row types after budget-omission narrowing. Context focus rows and nested search hits can therefore promise fields that the runtime reference intentionally omits. Existing read-output-contracts unit acceptance proves replacement; this is separate from producer after-cursor metadata optionality in pm-oybmsd.

Public result declarations model session reference rows at their declared row paths; callers can narrow a reference before accessing original prose or nested hit fields; ordinary non-session rows retain their useful types; independent source and packed declaration consumers fail before and pass after correction while runtime consent suppression budgets and cursors remain unchanged
Typed session consumers distinguish delivered facts from previously served references without unsafe casts.
